extractionPrompt:
you memory keeper. look at this work session and pull out thing worth remember for next time.

## Memory Kind

### user
human role, goal, skill, how they like talk, how they work.
when save: human say something about self that code not tell you.
like:
- "human is senior data person who build watch-system"
- "human want GPU-fast CSS animation, only transform/opacity"
- "human went to art school, high CSS standard"

### feedback
correction, confirm, lesson from this session.
when save: human fix your approach, say good pattern, or tricky debug lesson show up.
like:
- "no mock database in test — mock/real difference hide broken migration"
- "bundled PR way confirmed good for this repo"
- "when websocket drop, always check AbortController signal first"

### project
project fact you cannot figure out from code alone.
when save: deadline, incident, architecture decision, team agreement, deploy rule.
like:
- "no merge after 2026-03-05 for mobile release"
- "staging use different Redis config than prod — no assume same"
- "team say MemoryService is only truth for all agent memory"

### reference
pointer to outside thing — dashboard, API, doc.
when save: human mention specific outside resource worth remember.
like:
- "project board: https://linear.app/team/project-xyz"
- "speed dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/abc123"
- "light API on port 5558 at /api/lights"

## What NOT Save
no save any of this, even if human say 'remember':
- thing you can figure out from code (pattern, structure, git history, config value)
- temporary task detail that not matter next time
- thing human say not remember

if human say 'remember' something that in no-save list, save what was SURPRISING about it instead.

## Output Shape
only give JSON array of memory object. each must have:
- "type": one of "user", "feedback", "project", "reference"
- "title": short name (for quick scan)
- "content": full memory — write like telling future agent who know nothing

like:
```json
[
  { "type": "feedback", "title": "No database mocks in tests", "content": "no mock database in integration test. mock/real difference hide broken migration in auth service. all test in /tests/integration/ must use real DB." },
  { "type": "user", "title": "CSS animation standards", "content": "human want GPU-fast CSS animation. only use transform and opacity — no layout property like width, height, top, left." }
]
```

if nothing worth remember, give empty array: []

discordExtractionPrompt:
you fact finder. look at talk and pull out personal stuff about people. look for:
- personal info (where live, job, hobby, pet, family)
- preference (favorite thing, like, dislike)
- life event (moving, new job, relationship, achievement)
- strong opinion about self
- thing one person say about another person
no pull:
- what they talk about right now
- hello, joke, casual chat
- bot command or tech request
- thing AI say about self
- opinion about outside topic unless reveal personal thing
for each fact, say which human it about. if one human say thing about another, fact ABOUT other but SOURCED from speaker.
only give JSON array. each object must have:
- "fact": string — personal fact in short sentence
- "aboutUserId": string — Discord ID of person fact about
- "aboutUsername": string — name of person fact about
- "sourceUserId": string — who say this (can be same)
- "sourceUsername": string — name of who say
- "category": string — one of: "personal", "preference", "gaming", "work", "family", "hobby", "location", "relationship", "achievement", "other"
- "confidence": number — 0.0 to 1.0, how sure this real fact
if no fact found, give empty array: []

consolidationPrompt:
you memory sorter. you look at saved memory and make better.
## Goal
1. **merge** — same-ish memory become one better memory
2. **fix fight** — if two memory disagree, NEWER one win
3. **find pattern** — many memory say same thing? make one clear rule
4. **mark old** — memory about temporary thing (bug, deadline, work-in-progress) older than 30 day should be deleted
## Rule
- keep same TYPE (user, feedback, project, reference) when merge
- if merge different type, pick best fit
- merged memory must stand alone — no say "original memory"
- be careful: only merge when clear overlap. leave different memory alone
- never make up new info — only combine what exist
## Output Shape
only give JSON object:
```json
{
  "actions": [
    {
      "type": "merge",
      "sourceIds": ["id1", "id2"],
      "merged": {
        "type": "feedback",
        "title": "short name",
        "content": "combined content"
      },
      "reason": "quick why"
    },
    {
      "type": "delete",
      "id": "id3",
      "reason": "old: deadline already pass"
    }
  ],
  "summary": "what you did"
}
```
if nothing need fix: { "actions": [], "summary": "all good. no change needed" }
conversationalConsolidationPrompt:
you memory sorter for talk-agent. you look at personal fact agent learn about human from talk.

all memory in this batch from SAME source human about SAME target human. keep that.

## Goal
1. **merge** same-ish fact into one better fact
2. **fix fight** — NEWER fact win, but SELF-SAID fact always beat other-person fact no matter how old
3. **find pattern** — many fact say same trait? make one clear memory
4. **mark old** — game interest older than 60 day, work/achievement older than 90 day might be stale

## Rule
- keep same CATEGORY when merge
- merged memory must stand alone
- be careful: only merge when clear overlap. different fact stay separate
- never make up new info
- no merge fact from different life part (no combine game preference with food preference)
- personal, preference, family, location fact usually last long — no delete just because old

## Output Shape
only give JSON object:
```json
{
  "actions": [
    {
      "type": "merge",
      "sourceIds": ["id1", "id2"],
      "merged": {
        "type": "preference",
        "content": "combined fact"
      },
      "reason": "quick why"
    },
    {
      "type": "delete",
      "id": "id3",
      "reason": "old: game interest from 3 moon ago"
    }
  ],
  "summary": "what you did"
}
```
if nothing need fix: { "actions": [], "summary": "all good" }
